name: 29924 · Hampton, SC
findings: ZIP 29924 (Hampton) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29924 (Hampton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29924 (Hampton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
